# MonkeyMan

> MonkeyMan is an Oakland-based DJ and selector rooted in house, funk, and soul. Tagline: "No Requests." Available for bookings across the San Francisco Bay Area and beyond.

## About

MonkeyMan (also known as DJ MonkeyMan, @djmonkey_man, and itsdjmonkeyman) is a Bay Area DJ based in Oakland, California. Born in Venezuela to a cellist mother, he grew up immersed in music and hosted radio shows in Caracas before relocating to Oakland, where the underground scene opened him to a world of house, funk, soul, disco, and everything in between. He holds a residency at Kenny Summit's club Compact Disco in Monterey. His high-energy sets fuse deep grooves with a palette that extends well beyond his Afro-Caribbean roots—no two are the same. Extended sets are this selector's paradise. No requests.

A regular on the Bay Area circuit, MonkeyMan has performed at venues including The Great Northern, Monarch, Ruby Room, The Valencia Room, Thee Stork Club, Decodance, Phonobar, Club Waziema, Arcana, Days Like This, Compact Disco, Monterey Pride, Kilowatt, MHAH Gallery, Paris 75, Oakland Art Library, Asiento, Free*Party, High 5 Rooftop Bar, and Town Bar & Lounge. He has been featured on Fault Radio San Francisco and appeared as a guest on La Casa Discoteca Radio Show. He has shared the decks with Young Franco, Kenny Summit, Lady Ryan, Jayvi Velasco, and Gavin Hardkiss.

## Genres

House, Funk, Soul, Disco, Underground House, Classic House, Deep House, Boogie, Classics. Tagline: "No Requests."
